summary: Frontend validation of the 5 new Arabic pages (/ar/goldcar, /ar/truckline, /ar/autocare, /ar/used-cars, /ar/sustainability), homepage Instagram embeds, dark-text logo swap, language toggle mapping for the new routes, Arabic nav dropdowns, Arabic AuctionTimer with Arabic unit letters, English /used-cars regression, and console-error regression on /, /ar, /ar/about, /europcar. All items pass with no app-level runtime errors (third-party GTM/Instagram noise ignored per instructions).
critical_code_review_comments: Instagram embed relies on scripts.instagram.com; ensure a graceful fallback (branded card already handles this well).
Consider adding a subtle loading placeholder for Instagram iframes to prevent CLS on slow networks.

Branded [data-testid='instagram-embed'] card still present. Language toggle maps all 5 new routes correctly in both directions. Arabic /ar nav brands-dropdown contains the 4 brand AR links; about-dropdown contains /ar/sustainability. AR home page has links to /ar/goldcar and /ar/truckline (2 occurrences each — hero and section). No app runtime errors on /, /ar, /ar/about, /europcar.
